get.description: Evaluation traces (`environment = llmobs-eval`) and experiment traces are excluded unless `include_eval` or `include_experiments` is set. Series have one point per bucket. Latencies and TTFT are nanoseconds. Costs are USD. Results are cached for 10 seconds. The evaluation cost series always counts evaluation traces (spec 05 § Dashboard metrics).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter DSL expression. Applied to the view each series is computed on (spec 05).

parameters.name: include_eval
parameters.description: Include traces from the evaluation environment. Default false. Spec 05 § Default exclusions.

ApiKey.description: A project API key. The secret is not a field.

created_by.description: User who created the key. Omitted when that user is unknown.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working. Omitted when the key does not expire.

last_used_at.description: Last successful authentication. Omitted until a flush has written it.

name.description: Display name. Omitted when the key was created without one.

prefix.description: Type prefix plus the first 6 random characters.

ApiKeyPage.description: One page of results. `next_cursor` is null when there is no next page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

AuthConfig.description:
Login methods the UI should offer.

`GET /api/auth/config`. Spec 08 § Sign-up policy and spec 09 § Auth.

email_verification_required.description: New accounts must verify their email before signing in.

password_enabled.description: Password login is enabled. False when `LLMOBS_AUTH_DISABLE_PASSWORD` is set.

setup_required.description: No user exists yet, so the UI shows the setup page.

signup.description: Who may create an account after bootstrap.

smtp_enabled.description: SMTP is configured, so password reset and verification email can be sent.

AuthProvider.description:
One OAuth or OIDC provider the UI can start a login with.

Spec 08 § OAuth / OIDC. `id` matches `identities.provider`.

display_name.description: Name shown on the login button.

BlobPart.description: Inline base64 media, before extraction replaces it with a URI.

mime_type.description: MIME type, when known. Omitted when absent. An explicit `null` from the source is kept (D65).

modality.description: Media kind, when known. Omitted when absent. An explicit `null` from the source is kept (D65).

current_password.description: The current password. Required when the account has one, and absent when it does not.

ColumnSchema.description:
One column of a logical view.

Spec 05 § Logical views.

column_type.description: Type the filter UI uses to pick operators.

nullable.description: Whether the column may be null.

ColumnType.description:
Column type the filter UI understands.

Spec 05 § Logical views.

Convention.description:
An instrumentation convention detected on a span.

Spec 01 `conventions` and spec 02 § Convention detection.

CostSource.description:
Where a span's cost came from.

Spec 01 `cost_source`.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working. Absent when the key does not expire.

name.description: Display name, at most 100 characters. Absent when the key has none.

scopes.description: Secret keys default to ingest, read, and write. Public keys default to feedback.

slug.description: URL slug. Absent derives one from the name.

retention_days.description: Days to keep data, from 1 to 36500. Absent keeps data forever.

slug.description: URL slug. Absent derives one from the name. Project slugs are not reserved words.

is_default.description: Default view for this kind. Default false.

shared.description: Visible to every member of the project. Default false.

state.description: Opaque UI state: list-page URL params, or `{query, params}` for SQL.

CreatedApiKey.description: `POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/api-keys`. The response is the only place the secret appears.

key.description: The stored key, without the secret.

secret.description: The bearer value. Shown only in this response.

EndUserDetail.description:
User summary plus the most recent sessions.

Spec 09 § Response shapes.

sessions.description: The user's most recent sessions. At most [`MAX_USER_SESSIONS`].

EndUserPage.description: One page of results. `next_cursor` is null when there is no next page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

EndUserSummary.description:
One row of the end-user list.

`first_seen` is the minimum trace `start_time` and `last_seen` the maximum `end_time`.
`error_count` is the sum of the traces' `error_count`. Spec 09 § Observability data.

cost_total.description: Sum of trace costs, USD. Omitted when every trace omitted the field.

first_seen.description: Earliest trace start, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

last_seen.description: Latest trace end, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

total_tokens.description: Sum of trace token totals. Omitted when every trace omitted the field.

FieldError.description:
One field that failed validation.

Spec 09 § Conventions.

field.description: Request field, query parameter, or expression the error refers to.

message.description: What is wrong with the field.

position.description: Location inside the field value, for filter and SQL errors.

FunctionSchema.description:
One function the filter DSL or SQL console can call.

Spec 05 § Filter DSL.

in_filter.description: Whether the filter DSL allows the function.

in_sql.description: Whether the SQL console allows the function.

signature.description: Argument and return types, for example `score(name: string) -> float`.

Kpi.description:
One headline number.

`previous` covers the same-length period just before `from`. Spec 05 § Dashboard metrics.

previous.description: Value over the previous range. Omitted when that range has no data.

value.description: Value over `[from, to)`. Omitted when the range has no data.

Limit.description:
Page size. Default 50, accepted range 1–1000.

Spec 09 § Conventions.

Me.description:
The signed-in user and the orgs they belong to.

`GET /api/auth/me`. Spec 09 § Auth.

orgs.description: Orgs the user belongs to, with their org role.

MemberUser.description: A user as seen by the other members of an org.

name.description: Display name. Omitted when the user has not set one.

Message.description: One message in a conversation. Spec 01 § Canonical message format.

finish_reason.description: Why generation stopped. Omitted when absent. An explicit `null` from the source is kept (D65).

name.description: Optional speaker name. Omitted when absent. An explicit `null` from the source is kept (D65).

parts.description: Message parts. Always present; empty when the message has none.

MessageRole.description: Message speaker. Known values are `system`, `user`, `assistant`, and `tool`. Any other string is kept.

MetricName.description:
Series name.

Latencies and TTFT are nanoseconds as `f64`. Costs are USD. Spec 05 § Dashboard metrics.

MetricPoint.description:
One bucket of a series.

Spec 05 § Dashboard metrics.

time.description: Bucket start, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

value.description: Bucket value. Omitted when the bucket has no data.

MetricSeries.description:
One time series.

Every series has one point per bucket from `from` to `to`. Spec 05 § Dashboard metrics.

group.description: Group key: the `group_by` value, a model, or a score name. Omitted when the series is not split.

MetricsBucket.description:
Width of each metrics bucket.

Spec 05 § Dashboard metrics.

MetricsGroupBy.description:
Dimension that splits series which are not already split.

Spec 05 § Dashboard metrics.

from.description: Inclusive range start, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

group_by.description: Split applied to series that are not already split. Omitted when absent.

kpis.description: Headline numbers for the range and the previous range of the same length.

series.description: One point per bucket, for every series.

to.description: Exclusive range end, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

top_models.description: At most 10 models, by cost descending.
